title: TrueNAS - Operations Center
description: Comprehensive TrueNAS dashboard: system health, CPU, memory, ZFS pools & ARC, disks, network, services, shares, apps, VMs, boot environments, hardware/IPMI, alerts, tasks, security, advanced protocols, and exporter diagnostics.

options.content:
# TrueNAS Operations Center

Comprehensive monitoring covering **system health, CPU, memory, ZFS pools & ARC, disks, network, services, shares, apps, VMs, boot environments, hardware, alerts, tasks, security posture, and exporter diagnostics**.

> **Tip:** start with `$instance`, then narrow by `$pool`, `$dataset`, `$disk`, `$service`, `$app`, or `$method`. Collapsed detail rows keep the default view fast.

panels.title: CPU Usage
panels.description: Total and per-core CPU usage. TrueNAS 25.10 no longer reports CPU mode splits.

panels.title: Load Average
panels.description: Load average vs CPU core count. Load above core count means queueing.

panels.title: Per-Core CPU Usage
panels.description: Per-core utilization. Helps identify single-threaded bottlenecks.

panels.title: CPU Temperature per Core
panels.description: Per-core CPU temperatures. Sustained high temps indicate cooling issues.

panels.title: ARC Free Memory
panels.description: Memory the documented realtime event reports as free to the ZFS ARC.

panels.title: RAM Used %
panels.description: Derived from documented physical-memory total and available values.

panels.title: Memory Capacity Over Time
panels.description: Physical memory fields explicitly documented by reporting.realtime; used is total minus available.

panels.title: Documented ARC Memory Over Time
panels.description: ARC memory fields explicitly documented by reporting.realtime.

panels.title: Oldest Snap
panels.description: Age of the oldest snapshot. Very old snapshots may waste space.

panels.title: Pool Utilization
panels.description: Per-pool fill ratio. Pools above 80% suffer performance degradation.

panels.title: Top Dataset Utilization
panels.description: Datasets closest to filling their available space.

panels.title: Pool Capacity Trends
panels.description: Pool allocated and free space over time for capacity planning.

panels.title: Pool Fragmentation
panels.description: Pool fragmentation over time. High fragmentation degrades performance.

panels.title: Pool Scan Progress
panels.description: Active scrub or resilver progress per pool.

panels.title: Pool Inventory
panels.description: Pool capacity, health, dedup-table footprint, and active expansion progress.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (pool) (truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / clamp_min(max by (pool) (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}), 1)

panels.title: Pool Expansion Progress
panels.description: Completion percentage for active pool expansion reflow.

panels.title: ARC Size
panels.description: Current documented ZFS ARC cache size.

panels.title: Demand Hit & Miss Rates
panels.description: Documented ARC demand-data and demand-metadata hit and miss rates.

panels.title: ARC Memory Headroom
panels.description: Documented ARC free and available memory fields.

panels.title: Demand & L2ARC Hit Ratios
panels.description: Cache hit ratios — higher is better.

panels.title: Demand Data & Metadata Rates
panels.description: Demand access rates for data and metadata.

panels.title: L2ARC Throughput
panels.description: L2ARC I/O. High write with low hit ratio signals cache churn.

panels.title: Disk Throughput by Device
panels.description: Read/write throughput for the busiest devices.

panels.title: Disk Inventory
panels.description: Per-disk capacity, performance, temperature, and media type.

panels.title: SMB1
panels.description: Legacy SMB1 protocol enabled (insecure when on).

panels.title: SMB Conns
panels.description: Active SMB tree connections (live, from smb.status).

panels.title: SMB Open Files
panels.description: Open SMB file locks (live, from smb.status).

panels.title: ImmediateData
panels.description: Active iSCSI sessions with immediate-data enabled.

panels.title: Used Disks
panels.description: Disks currently in use by pools.

panels.title: Service Inventory
panels.description: Service runtime state and boot enablement.

panels.title: DH RL Error
panels.description: DockerHub rate-limit endpoint currently reports an error.

panels.title: DockerHub Rem
panels.description: DockerHub pull requests remaining in current window.

panels.title: DockerHub Limit
panels.description: DockerHub pull limit window total requests.

panels.title: DH Window Left
panels.description: Seconds remaining in the current DockerHub pull-limit window.

panels.title: App Upgrades
panels.description: Apps with a newer chart or package version available.

panels.title: Migrated Apps
panels.description: Apps migrated from the older Kubernetes stack.

panels.title: Img Updates
panels.description: Apps with container image updates available.

panels.title: Apps by Container Count
panels.description: Apps with the largest active workload footprint.

panels.title: App State Distribution
panels.description: Current state mix across installed apps.

panels.title: App Container State Distribution
panels.description: Current runtime state mix across app containers.

panels.title: App Inventory
panels.description: App resource footprint, update posture, and exposure summary.

panels.title: AMD ASIDs
panels.description: AMD Address Space Identifiers are supported.

panels.title: VM Memory Allocation
panels.description: VM memory available vs in use.

panels.title: Reboot Req
panels.description: Reboot required to finish pending changes.

panels.title: Abortable
panels.description: Active jobs that can be cancelled.

panels.title: Last Alert Activity
panels.description: Age since the most recent alert occurrence.

panels.title: Running Job Progress
panels.description: Progress of currently running jobs by method.

panels.title: Active Jobs by State
panels.description: Current active job counts split by WAITING and RUNNING state.

panels.title: Oldest Active Job Age
panels.description: Age of the oldest active job in each state.

panels.title: Job Method Detail
panels.description: Active job counts and progress by middleware method.

panels.title: Alert Source and Node Detail
panels.description: Current alert counts grouped by source and by node.

panels.title: Task Enablement Detail
panels.description: Task enablement from documented task query fields.

panels.title: 2FA
panels.description: Two-factor auth (disabled is a security finding).

panels.title: Dir Faults
panels.description: Enabled directory services reporting a fault.

panels.title: FIPS Avail
panels.description: FIPS capability is available on this system.

targets.expr: label_replace(max(truenas_local_user_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Local Users", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_local_group_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Local Groups", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_certificate_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Certificates", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_privilege_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Privileges", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max(truenas_keychain_credential_count{instance=~"$instance"}), "category", "Keychain Creds", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Certificate Expiry
panels.description: Certificate expiry in operator-friendly relative and absolute forms.

panels.title: Activated BEs
panels.description: Boot environments selected for the next boot.

panels.title: Boot Environment Used Space
panels.description: Bytes used by each boot environment.

panels.title: GPU Host Avail
panels.description: GPUs available to the TrueNAS host.

panels.title: Datasets Using Snapshot Space
panels.description: Datasets consuming the most space in snapshots.

panels.title: Dataset Capacity Detail
panels.description: Detailed dataset capacity, encryption, quota, and snapshot info.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) / clamp_min(max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) + max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_available_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}), 1)

panels.title: Dataset Policy Detail
panels.description: Dataset encryption, policy flags, quota thresholds, and age.

panels.title: Methods OK %
panels.description: Share of API methods whose latest scrape call succeeded (not a call-level success rate).

panels.title: API Errors (1h)
panels.description: API call errors in the last hour; returns to 0 after recovery.

panels.title: Coll Errors (1h)
panels.description: Collector errors in the last hour; returns to 0 after recovery.

panels.title: Oldest Alert Age
panels.description: Age of the oldest active alert.

panels.title: Boot Env Next
panels.description: Boot environments selected for the next boot.

panels.title: Demand Access/s
panels.description: Total ARC demand accesses per second.

panels.title: Exporter & Event Stream Health
panels.description: Telemetry collection health (collector errors shown as a rate, not a lifetime total).

panels.title: Advanced ZFS Ratios
panels.description: Advanced ARC/L2ARC percentage metrics from realtime telemetry.

panels.title: Advanced ZFS Access & Miss Rates
panels.description: Advanced demand and L2ARC activity rates.

panels.title: Exporter Version
panels.description: Exporter build version label currently active per instance.

panels.title: Boot Environment Flags
panels.description: Current, next-boot, and retention flags for rollback planning.

panels.title: API Method Detail
panels.description: Per-method duration, success flag, and errors.
